description.zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示当前页（从1开始）
description.en: The current page number (starting from 1). This field is present when pagination is used.

description.zh: 每页返回数目，默认 pageSize=10
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 根据状态过滤实例列表，如果指定了本字段，将会过出对应状态的实例列表
description.en: Filters the instance list by status. If this field is specified, only instances with the corresponding status are returned.

descriptions.zh: 本接口用于获取被 SysOM 纳管的机器列表。
descriptions.en: Retrieves the list of machines managed by SysOM.
